title: Cosmic Desert Meltdown
description: A surreal desert landscape features a massive crumbling celestial body resembling a black hole or planet with a glowing orange eye at its center, dripping vibrant molten colors. In the background stands a stepped adobe pyramid, two large pastel moons, a comet streaking across a colorful nebula sky filled with translucent bubbles.
